verdict.rationale: Skyvern is explicitly documented as self-hostable, running entirely on the developer's own infrastructure, servers, browsers, and LLM keys, with no cloud account required (skyvern-docs-2, skyvern-docs-12). A runtime probe confirms the OSS package installs locally via pip and the CLI operates a local Skyvern environment (skyvern-probe-rt-2), corroborating this is a real, working local dev workflow rather than just a marketing claim. missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation specifically of a local browser session (vs. the cloud-Chromium CDP path mentioned for the SDK in skyvern-docs-5), and explicit instructions/flags for pointing at a local browser instance
